items.title: EQT-owned Virtusa seeks India banks for $7 billion IPO
items.subject: Virtusa
items.why: EQT is preparing a listing of Virtusa in India or ANZ ($7 billion) after 5y 8m, in the exit window: pre-IPO tech VDD and the equity story get scoped now.
items.call: Call the EQT portfolio team this week: pitch the pre-IPO tech VDD and the technology chapter of the equity story.

items.title: GIC Acquires 16 Hotel Marriott Portfolio from KKR
items.subject: Marriott
items.why: KKR has agreed to sell Marriott in Southeast Asia: VDD is spent; the buyer owns integration and KKR has proceeds to redeploy.
items.call: Two calls: the buyer’s deal team on integration, and the KKR team on what the proceeds go into next.

items.title: TPG agrees ₩1.3 trillion deal for majority stake in Lotte Rental
items.subject: Lotte Rental
items.why: TPG has agreed to buy Lotte Rental in North Asia (1.3 trillion): buy-side DD is done and the post-close tech agenda is open.
items.call: Pitch the TPG deal team the 100-day tech plan, an AI-readiness review and, if a carve-out, the separation work.

items.title: EQT Group to invest $50bn in India over 4 years
items.why: EQT plans to deploy ($50bn) in India or ANZ: a pipeline about to fill.
items.call: Relationship touchpoint: ask the EQT team which sectors the capital goes to, and get SSG on the diligence panel.

items.title: TPG Explores Hybrid ADR Structure With New and Existing Shares as Kakao Mobility Exit Stalls
items.subject: Kakao Mobility
items.why: TPG is preparing a listing of Kakao Mobility in Asia after 9y 3m, in the exit window: pre-IPO tech VDD and the equity story get scoped now.
items.call: Call the TPG portfolio team this week: pitch the pre-IPO tech VDD and the technology chapter of the equity story.

items.title: EQT launches evergreen EQT Nexus Asia strategy for Asia-Pacific buyouts
items.subject: Nexus
items.why: EQT has set up a new strategy or team in India or ANZ: they will need repeatable diligence partners.
items.call: Ask the EQT team how the new platform picks advisers, and get SSG on the panel early.

items.title: KKR (KKR) Joined A Non Binding Bid For Uniper SE
items.subject: Uniper SE
items.why: KKR is in a live process for Uniper SE: bids are moving and the diligence window is open.
items.call: Call the KKR deal team now: confirmatory tech DD, and a red-flag view on the stack if they are not yet in exclusivity.

items.title: KKR Closes Record $19.2B Global Infrastructure Fund V
items.subject: Record
items.why: KKR has closed a fund ($19.2B): fresh dry powder and a deployment pipeline about to fill.
items.call: Relationship touchpoint: congratulate the KKR team and ask where the new fund deploys in APAC.

items.title: Wavenet Acquire Qubic Group
items.subject: Qubic
items.why: Wavenet, a Macquarie Capital portfolio company, is buying Qubic: the integration plan is the open question.
items.call: Call the Macquarie Capital deal team covering Wavenet: stack consolidation, data migration and product overlap.

items.title: KKR-Backed FiberCop to Appoint Marco Nespolo as CEO | Finance News
items.subject: FiberCop
items.why: A senior move at KKR: a relationship to open before their first deal needs an adviser.
items.call: Send a note this week and ask for 20 minutes; bring the APAC software view.
